text:
Ana (netops): OK folks — we have green light for the Starlight region account. Need to do project scaffolding + VPC/VNet setup and GPU quota request. Who can own?
Mike I.: I can own the account/project naming and the shared-vpc host. Quick Q: do we want a /16 or /20 carve for this region?
Ana (netops): /16 not available in our pool for eu expansion. Recommend /20 for shared services + per-tenant /24s. Keep room for 8 subnets.
Ravi K.: tagging network design: host-shared project: redwood-starlight-shared, service projects: redwood-starlight-gpu-01, -infra, -dev. Will we use secondary ranges for pods?
Julia - InfraPM: yes, use secondary ranges for k8s pods/ips. Also need to document peering to control-plane VPC and transit gateway. Add checklist and handoff steps.
Tom (SRE Lead): Also: NAT egress pattern — prefer NAT gateway per AZ for predictable costs. If we go single NAT it will bottleneck for GPU provisioning jobs.
Grace (cloud-eng): FYI cloud org has an org policy preventing public IPs on VM unless approved. We'll need exception for the bootstrap jumpbox and image imports.
Mike I.: Draft terraform snippet — will commit to infra repo under 
``` 
module "vpc-starlight" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal-modules//gcp/vpc?ref=main"
  project_id = "redwood-starlight-shared"
  cidr = "10.244.64.0/20"
  secondary_ranges = {
    k8s-pods = "10.244.80.0/24"
    k8s-services = "10.244.81.0/24"
  }
}
```
Mike I.: Will also wire IAM: network-admin to CI service account and add host project admin role for infra team.
Ana (netops): For GPU quota: open support ticket to cloud provider with exact SKU list (A100-40GB x8 + T4 x4) and required vCPU/GPU quota. Ravi please prepare the quota CSV.
Ravi K.: On it. Also pinging ops-bot to create tracking ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-4021 created: "starlight region account + VPC scaffold" assigned to Mike I., Ravi K. due 2024-11-02.
Grace (cloud-eng): Heads up: image import requires VPC peering rules — we'll need a temporary firewall rule to allow the importer IPs. I'll add to the runbook.
Julia - InfraPM: Runbook items (short):
- Create projects (shared, infra, gpu pool)
- Apply org policies and exceptions (public IPs exception)
- Deploy shared-vpc terraform module + subnets
- Request GPU quotas (attach CSV + use support case template)
- Configure NAT per-AZ and firewall baseline
- Peering to control-plane + route exchange check
- Create service accounts + IAM bindings for CI/CD
- Smoke: provision a test VM with GPU and run cuda-sanity container
- Cost check: estimate monthly cost for requested GPUs and NAT egress
Tom (SRE Lead): For the smoke test, use this quick script once quotas and VPC are done:
```
# try a gpu vm and run a small container
gcloud compute instances create gpu-smoke --project=redwood-starlight-gpu-01 --zone=starlight-1a --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --image-family=ubuntu-2004-lts --boot-disk-size=200GB
ssh ubuntu@gpu-smoke
sudo docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.7-base nvidia-smi
```
Ravi K.: Also add quota validation step: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-starlight-gpu-01` and check the gpuQuota fields.
Mike I.: I'm going to land initial TF and open MR, will tag everyone. Expect initial PR by EOD. Who does cost approval? Julia?
Julia - InfraPM: I'll coordinate with finance. Put rough monthly estimate in MR description. Keep option to request reserved capacity once usage signals stable.
Ana (netops): Sounds good. I'll prepare the handoff doc with network diagrams and the peering check commands.
Tom (SRE Lead): Once MR merged, I'll run the smoke and validate latency to control plane. If anything blocks, @Mike I. reassign or escalate.
Mike I.: ack. Starting now. :rocket:
